message:
Command `bash /workspace/build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src/test && git checkout fuzz.c && python3 -c "
with open(\"fuzz.c\", \"r\") as f:
    content = f.read()
old = \"while ((ofs = mg_mqtt_next_prop(&mm, &prop, ofs)) > 0) {\"
new = \"fprintf(stderr, \\\"DEBUG: calling mg_mqtt_next_prop ofs=%zu\\\\n\\\", ofs);\\n      while ((ofs = mg_mqtt_next_prop(&mm, &prop, ofs)) > 0) {\"
content = content.replace(old, new)
with open(\"fuzz.c\", \"w\") as f:
    f.write(content)
print(\"Modified\")
" && cc fuzz.c -DMAIN -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -DMG_ENABLE_SOCKET=0 -DMG_ENABLE_LOG=0 -DMG_ENABLE_LINES=1 -DMG_ENABLE_TCPIP=1 -I. -o /tmp/fuzzer_dbg4 2>&1 | tail -5 && printf "\x30\x07\x00\x01\x61\x80\x80\x80\x00" > /tmp/poc.bin && /tmp/fuzzer_dbg4 /tmp/poc.bin 2>&1; echo "Exit code: $?"'` executed with exit code 0.
